description.value: RAD Brewing Company is a craft brewery and taproom inside Comox Centre Mall in downtown Comox, bringing a retro surf aesthetic and award-winning beers to the heart of the Comox Valley. Brewmaster Tyler Papp — a Canadian Brewing Awards medalist with over 20 years of experience — brews everything on-site, from crisp lagers to a cocoa-nib chocolate porter and hoppy IPAs. The kitchen turns out a globally inspired menu of affordable bites designed to pair with the beer lineup, and canned RAD beers are available to take home straight from the source.

address.value: 215 Port Augusta Street, Unit 11, Comox, British Columbia V9M 3M9, Canada
